supplemental_items.interpretation: Early stop compares previous exact event with current exact formation, but frozen range ends at current formation main open minus microsecond. Can be reversed even when guard passes, in which case A08 raises. Formation search uses exact formation time to min(main end,expiry), end excluded. On hit previous actual stop main retained, current effective stop main is trigger.
